_about: Corrections to the vendored Smithy model, for shapes whose declared
pattern is stricter than the service it describes. A corrected pattern
keeps the member validated against what AWS really returns; the
alternative, listing the field as an accepted violation, would stop
Each correction pins the exact upstream pattern it replaces. If a
re-vendor changes that pattern, the loader fails rather than applying a
correction to text it was never written against.

_evidence: DescribeConfigurationTemplates names the resource a template applies
to in CloudFormation spelling — "AWS::WAFv2::WebACL" — and the
declared pattern admits no ":", so no value the service returns for
this member can match it. The correction admits the colon and changes
DescribeFieldIndexes reports the DEFAULT index category, which the
"@data_format", and logs-field-indexing lists the default indexes of
every Standard-class log group starting with "@logStream". The declared
pattern admits no "@", so no default index name the service returns can
match it. The correction admits the at sign and changes nothing else.
